{{Top|leg}}
'''EeZee Too-Onebee''' was a malfunctioning [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] that performed illegal [[Vessel (cyborg)|vessel]] and [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] implants in the back corridors of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]]. Basic vessel jobs started at 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while fully bord implants could cost as much as 125,000 credits. Numerous [[Information broker/Legends|infochants]] of the outpost sent their employees to the medical droid for the operations, even though EeZee Too-Onebee never offered a guarantee.
